WITH annual AS (
  SELECT
    c.Segment,
    ym.CustomerID,
    SUM(ym.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
  FROM yearmonth AS ym
  JOIN customers AS c
    ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_annual_consumption
  FROM annual
  GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
  SELECT
    a.Segment,
    AVG(a.annual_consumption) AS annual_avg_consumption
  FROM annual AS a
  JOIN segment_min AS m
    ON a.Segment = m.Segment
   AND a.annual_consumption = m.min_annual_consumption
  GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS difference_sme_lam,
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS difference_lam_kam,
  (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS difference_kam_sme;

WITH annual AS (SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS annual_consumption FROM yearmonth AS ym JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID), segment_min AS (SELECT Segment, MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_annual_consumption FROM annual GROUP BY Segment), segment_avg AS (SELECT a.Segment, AVG(a.annual_consumption) AS annual_avg_consumption FROM annual AS a JOIN segment_min AS m ON a.Segment = m.Segment AND a.annual_consumption = m.min_annual_consumption GROUP BY a.Segment) SELECT (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS difference_sme_lam, (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS difference_lam_kam, (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS difference_kam_sme;

SELECT c.Segment,
       SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012,
       SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date,1,4)='2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
  AND substr(y.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY c.Segment;

WITH segment_totals AS (SELECT c.Segment, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013 FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013') GROUP BY c.Segment), pct AS (SELECT Segment, (cons_2013 - cons_2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(cons_2013, 0) AS pct_increase FROM segment_totals), max_seg AS (SELECT Segment, 1 AS ord FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1), min_seg AS (SELECT Segment, 2 AS ord FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1), combined AS (SELECT Segment, ord FROM max_seg UNION ALL SELECT Segment, ord FROM min_seg) SELECT Segment FROM combined ORDER BY ord;

WITH champion_times AS (
  SELECT
    r.year AS year,
    CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600
    + CAST(substr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), 1, instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
    + CAST(substr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS total_seconds
  FROM results AS res
  JOIN races AS r
    ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.year < 1975
    AND res.positionOrder = 1
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
    AND res.time NOT LIKE '+%'
)
SELECT
  year,
  AVG(total_seconds) AS average_time_seconds
FROM champion_times
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;
